data.body: **P2 — Do not reload environment plugins in the older-core fallback.** This effective list already includes instances selected by `DURABLE_EXECUTION_PLUGINS`. Passing it to a fresh older-core builder leaves dynamic discovery enabled, so another instance is prepended; that core lacks exclusivity validation, causing duplicate OTel spans and context/MDC management. When `toBuilder` is unavailable, avoid feeding dynamically discovered instances back into discovery or reject environment-based configuration clearly, and test this branch against the released core with the actual environment variable.
